# Bluesky

`bluesky` · openapi · version `1.0.0` · **published** · readiness `reviewed_publication_user_test_required`

Connect to Bluesky (AT Protocol) with an independent Ragentic integration: read profiles, feeds, threads and search, and post with an app password. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Bluesky.

## Operations (9)

Parameters marked * are required. Safe operations only read, so a preview may call them.

| Method | Path | Name | Parameters | Returns | Safe | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/xrpc/app.bsky.actor.getProfile` | getProfile | `actor`* | object | yes | Get an actor's profile |
| GET | `/xrpc/app.bsky.actor.searchActors` | searchActors | `term`, `q`, `limit`, `cursor` | object | yes | Search for actors (profiles) |
| GET | `/xrpc/app.bsky.feed.getAuthorFeed` | getAuthorFeed | `actor`*, `limit`, `cursor`, `filter`, `includePins` | object | yes | Get an actor's author feed |
| GET | `/xrpc/app.bsky.feed.getPostThread` | getPostThread | `uri`*, `depth`, `parentHeight` | object | yes | Get a post thread |
| GET | `/xrpc/app.bsky.feed.searchPosts` | searchPosts | `q`*, `sort`, `since`, `until`, `mentions`, `author`, `lang`, `domain`, `url`, `tag`, `limit`, `cursor` | object | yes | Search posts |
| POST | `/xrpc/com.atproto.repo.createRecord` | createRecord | body*: object | object |  | Create a record (for example a post) |
| POST | `/xrpc/com.atproto.repo.deleteRecord` | deleteRecord | body*: object | object |  | Delete a record |
| POST | `/xrpc/com.atproto.repo.uploadBlob` | uploadBlob | body*: string:binary | object |  | Upload a blob (image or video) for a record |
| GET | `/xrpc/com.atproto.server.getSession` | getSession | — | object | yes | Get the current session's account |
